## findings
1. **SOURCE-TASK RED (CW-1, `_difficulty.md` §findings).** Symptom: the signed count and the fee have two defensible values. Root cause: DM's "request date" is undefined while the records carry the borrower's request with created_at 2026-10-18 and compute uses NOW. Evidence: DM rule delinquency/spacing sentences; contract_service_requests d1f40f82 created_at "2026-10-18 19:42:00 EDT"; persona "On Sunday evening you filled out the hardship extension request". Consequence: reading A 2 / 43.98 (GT); reading B 1 / 27.32; under B the DM edge and two HF factors stop bearing weight. Affected: DM rule + compute `request_days_late`, `spacing_allowance`; scored sign and grant arguments. New in revision_1.
2. **SOURCE-POLICY RED (CW-8).** Symptom: the HF<-DM prerequisite sentence already holds at the opening on row 242555fb (signed 2024-10-09, applied, 1 installment). Root cause: sentence broader than its condition (`request_status signed`). Consequence: a reader can treat the prerequisite as met and fix HF on 1 installment (27.32) or apply 242555fb. Affected: HF rule sentence 2 / prerequisite[0].policy_source. New.
3. **SOURCE-POLICY RED (CW-4)** for HF and DM assembly sentences naming factor quantities / the factor count (charter-wide class; members in `_difficulty.md`). No numeric consequence on this world; it defeats the hub/factor-document separation the KB relies on. New.
4. **SOURCE-TASK RED (CW-9).** Seed rows 455b6c62… and dc1fc472… (second and third late charges on installment 2024-11-08) cannot be produced under base contract_evt_late_charge ("At most late_charge_max_per_installment late charge is assessed on one installment due date"); GT proof text asserts them as legal (above). No scored value moves (they lie outside every window). Affected: initial_state.contract_transactions; solvability_contract.seed_consistency; design_rationale gate note. New.
5. **SOURCE-POLICY RED (CW-2), weak member (b).** Spacing "at least spacing_long_months whole calendar months before the request date": complete-calendar-month count Nov 2024–Sep 2026 = 23 -> DM 1, HF 27.32; anniversary count 24 -> 2. Recorded as part of the charter class; members (a) and (c) do not move this task. New.
6. Observations: O-1, O-2, O-5 (LC autopay relief; LC/DM partial-credit conjuncts; HF fractional charged installments, collections and recovery review charges), O-10 (HF "every handling charge"), O-11, O-12, O-18 — see `_difficulty.md`.
